speaker: Doctor
text:
The repeated normal results for blood work and chest X-rays effectively rule out common infections, malignancies, and systemic inflammatory diseases. Given your persistent "B symptoms," I need to know if you have experienced any changes in your bowel habits, such as chronic diarrhea, or if you have had any difficulty swallowing or new lumps in your abdomen.

text: RESULTS: Splenomegaly palpable; bilateral cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma.

The palpable spleen and widespread lymphadenopathy in the neck and groin, combined with persistent "B symptoms" and normal initial workup, are highly suggestive of a lymphoproliferative disorder. I am requesting a CT Abdomen and Pelvis to stage the disease and assess for extranodal involvement.
